proposals.subtype: Rename the generated Scorer value type
proposals.explanation: CodeGenType("Scorer") maps the generated model to the public readonly partial struct QuestionAnsweringScorer. The otherwise empty body is not empty scaffolding because the attribute changes the generated type's public name.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom directory contains an explicit generator customization attribute on the renamed struct.

proposals.subtype: Construct key or audience-scoped bearer authentication pipelines
proposals.explanation: The constructor overloads validate endpoint/credential, supply default options when null, retain the options, create diagnostics and build a pipeline with either AzureKeyCredentialPolicy using AuthorizationHeader or BearerTokenAuthenticationPolicy using the selected audience plus /.default. Token construction defaults to AzurePublicCloud; both branches retain endpoint and version. Imported policy behavior and the AuthorizationHeader constant value are not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete credential constructor bodies are implemented on the non-Generated partial client, rather than inferred from its generated counterpart.

proposals.subtype: Expose the retained endpoint
proposals.explanation: The partial client adds a public virtual Endpoint getter returning _endpoint, without local URI transformation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The getter has a concrete implementation in the non-Generated client partial.

proposals.subtype: Project-based answer overloads populate a question or QnA ID
proposals.explanation: The synchronous GetAnswers overloads accept either a question or an integer QnA ID plus a project, create options only when absent, and mutate those options through WithQuestion or WithQnaId before internal dispatch. The internal path passes ProjectName and DeploymentName as separate operation arguments. WithQuestion rejects null/empty strings; neither setter clears the other selector field.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Public overload bodies and their concrete option setters appear in non-Generated partial source.

proposals.subtype: Async answer overloads adapt project and query selectors
proposals.explanation: The asynchronous GetAnswers overload group accepts a question or QnA ID and a QuestionAnsweringProject, updates supplied or newly created options, and returns the internal async dispatch task. That path passes project/deployment strings to another overload. Caller-supplied options are reused and mutated, not cloned.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated partial client implements both public async adapters and invokes concrete handwritten option setters.

proposals.subtype: Build text-answer options from string or typed document collections
proposals.explanation: Two synchronous GetAnswersFromText overloads validate question and document enumeration, resolve the optional language, call AnswersFromTextOptions.From for either string or TextDocument inputs, and delegate to the internal options-taking path with cancellation. The shared factory's document-ID conversion is identified separately.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both public overloads have executable adapter bodies in the non-Generated partial client.

proposals.subtype: Async text-answer facades construct options from two document forms
proposals.explanation: The two async GetAnswersFromText overloads validate question/documents, resolve language and construct options through From before returning internal async dispatch. Their public bodies are task-returning adapters, not independently implemented document transport or response decoding.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated partial contains both concrete async public facade implementations.

proposals.subtype: Trace answer dispatch with project and deployment attributes
proposals.explanation: GetAnswersInternal validates project/options, starts a QuestionAnsweringClient.GetAnswers diagnostic scope with az.cognitivelanguage.project.name and az.cognitivelanguage.deployment.name attributes, calls the flattened overload and marks the scope failed before rethrowing any caught exception.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This separate private helper implements explicit scope creation, tags and failure reporting in non-Generated source.

proposals.subtype: Trace awaited answer dispatch with project metadata
proposals.explanation: GetAnswersInternalAsync creates the same GetAnswers-named scope and project/deployment attributes, awaits the flattened operation with ConfigureAwait(false), and records failures before rethrowing. It does not swallow errors or substitute a result.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A distinct async private helper in the non-Generated partial explicitly manages the scope around awaited dispatch.

proposals.subtype: Trace text-answer dispatch after cloning request options
proposals.explanation: GetAnswersFromTextInternal validates options, starts a GetAnswersFromText diagnostic scope, replaces the local options variable with Clone(ClientOptions?.DefaultLanguage), calls the options-based overload, and records/rethrows exceptions. Unlike the project-query helper it adds no project/deployment attributes.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated partial implements this private synchronous scope-and-dispatch helper.

proposals.subtype: Trace async text-answer dispatch with clone and failure recording
proposals.explanation: GetAnswersFromTextInternalAsync validates and clones options with the stored default language inside a started GetAnswersFromText scope, awaits the options-based overload with ConfigureAwait(false), and marks failures before rethrowing.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This separate non-Generated async helper contains executable diagnostics and dispatch logic.

proposals.subtype: Create request options and number raw text documents
proposals.explanation: The string-document From overload validates question/documents and projects strings into TextDocument values with incrementing invariant-culture IDs starting at 1, then assigns Language. The typed-document overload validates question and forwards documents directly into the model constructor with Language assigned. The generated constructor's enumeration/materialization behavior is not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both concrete static factory overloads are implemented on the non-Generated options partial.

proposals.subtype: Clone selected request fields with a fallback language
proposals.explanation: Clone constructs a new AnswersFromTextOptions from Question and TextDocuments and sets Language to the existing value or the supplied fallback. The body does not explicitly copy StringIndexType or any other uncaptured generated option fields, and does not demonstrate a deep copy of documents.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated model partial contains this concrete internal clone implementation.

proposals.subtype: Initialize the request string-index option to UTF-16 code units
proposals.explanation: AnswersFromTextOptions adds a nullable StringIndexType property initialized from QuestionAnsweringClientOptions.DefaultStringIndexType, whose supplied definition returns Utf16CodeUnit. This is a declared request-option default, not proof of serializer or service offset behavior.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete property/default definitions appear in two non-Generated partial types.

proposals.subtype: Expose generated Top as AnswersOptions.Size
proposals.explanation: AnswersOptions maps the generated member Top onto a public nullable Size property through CodeGenMember, without implementing a local range check.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: An explicit member customization attribute defines the alias in the non-Generated options partial.

proposals.subtype: Expose generated Top as ShortAnswerOptions.Size
proposals.explanation: ShortAnswerOptions uses CodeGenMember("Top") to expose a public nullable Size. Its comment describes 1-to-10 span-prediction inputs, but the supplied property adds no validation or default.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated partial explicitly customizes a generated member with CodeGenMember.

proposals.subtype: Configure a client-wide fallback for text-query language
proposals.explanation: Client options add DefaultLanguage initialized to en, and the client's ResolveLanguage returns the supplied non-null value or ClientOptions?.DefaultLanguage. Empty strings are not replaced by this null-coalescing expression, and it does not validate BCP-47 tags.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-Generated options partial and client helper concretely implement the option and resolution rule.

proposals.subtype: Expose an audience option and cloud value helpers
proposals.explanation: QuestionAnsweringClientOptions adds a nullable Audience and the readonly partial QuestionAnsweringAudience supports custom nonempty string values, China/government/public-cloud constants and string conversion. The token constructor's use of this configuration is separately represented by client construction.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The option and concrete audience value type are implemented in src outside Generated under the supplied .NET rule.

proposals.subtype: Rename the generated inference model factory
proposals.explanation: CodeGenType maps LanguageQuestionAnsweringInferenceModelFactory onto QuestionAnsweringModelFactory. No factory method implementations are included in this otherwise empty partial body.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit generator type-name mapping changes API shape even though the partial class has no method body.

proposals.subtype: Group project/deployment names into a public query handle
proposals.explanation: QuestionAnsweringProject validates both constructor inputs against null and exposes ProjectName and DeploymentName as getter-only properties. This public parameter object is used by the supplied answer-query facades; its constructor does not reject empty strings or check that a deployment exists.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete class is supplied outside Generated with constructor validation and a distinct public model surface.

proposals.subtype: Add response headers and query identifiers to diagnostic logging lists
proposals.explanation: ConfigureLogging appends Operation-Location, Strict-Transport-Security, apim-request-id, x-content-type-options and x-envoy-upstream-service-time to LoggedHeaderNames, and deploymentName/projectName to LoggedQueryParameters. No call site is captured, so this implementation does not prove that the helper is installed or active for constructed clients.

This candidate equality behavior is distinct from configuring cloud audience constants and the client audience option.
